model.name: weft-specialist-v1
model.architecture: all-MiniLM-L6-v2 frozen base plus int8 link, theme, and evidence heads; the exported artifact carries the tokenized pair graph, the int8 per-row word-embedding table, MatMulNBits int4 FFN and attention-output matmuls (int4 artifact), and the metadata props with the tokenizer JSON, the OOD bank, and the sha-256 manifest pins
model.weightsInRepoNote: Trained weights stay on disk under a gitignored path by standing rule; the digests and sizes below pin the artifacts, and the reproduction recipe regenerates them.

reproduction.kaggleNotebookPattern: w5-quantized-export version 7, GPU run on 2x Tesla T4, seed 20261127; Kaggle's onnxruntime cannot import MatMulNBitsQuantizer until the standalone onnx-ir package is installed: onnx-ir==1.1.0 is the pinned requirement that unblocks the 4-bit export (found on the verification box by chance in versions 5 and 6, installed explicitly in version 7).
reproduction.conformalSplitNote: The calibration sweep walks the calibration half in descending-score order (a fixed-sequence Learn-Then-Test); entries before this fix were never appended to the repo ledger.

claimAudit.note: Append-only, content-addressed by runId; re-running with an unchanged card is a no-op.

benchmarkPointer.content: Per-bucket W1 shootout results for every baseline (bm25, model2vec static threshold, MiniLM L6 cosine, BERTopic-style, local LLM judge) on the synthetic-theme estate, with harness digests recorded in the ledger.

licenceGate.rule: Only sources with status green in results/weft-licence-audit.json may enter the public training recipe; no green, no release.
licenceGate.multiNews: Dropped by decision, not pending: the LILY Lab agreement limits use to non-commercial research and educational purposes only and grants no IP licence; the HF licence field is other.
licenceGate.ucdcr: Cited only, never redistributed; compilation tagged CC BY-SA 4.0 and states no per-corpus licence for its 12 constituents; ECB+ is CC BY-NC-SA (espRA, registration-gated).
licenceGate.releasedCorpus: Project-generated synthetic estates with permissively-licensed open-weight teacher outputs only.
licenceGate.wikipediaDerivedPairs: Excluded from the public set by the binding default; surfaces at the founder checkpoint if the founder chooses share-alike dataset licensing.

onnxruntimeNode.testedVersionNote: onnxruntime-node 1.31.1 is the tested version; the optionalDependency range in package.json is tightened from ^1.31.1 to ~1.31.1 so minor floats cannot change the metadata read silently.
onnxruntimeNode.couplingNote: onnxruntime-node 1.31.1 exposes no model-metadata API, so the W6 metadata read scans the ONNX protobuf field 14 directly; a runtime upgrade that adds a metadata API changes that code path, which is why the range does not float.
